besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses (die temperatuur is hoer / die dae is langer).
besluite.rede: Both halves have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

besluite.fout: Indefinite subject 'reen' without the expletive 'daar' reads stiff in the clause.
besluite.rede: 'hoeveel reen daar gewoonlik val' is the natural Afrikaans form and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Inverted indefinite subject 'reen' without 'daar' reads unnatural.
besluite.rede: 'val daar reen deur die jaar' is the natural construction and says the same thing.
